edges.reason: Constructor assigns the Uniswap router instance to the uniswapV2Router state variable.
Constructor reads owner() to seed the fee-exclusion mapping.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
transfer delegates all accounting to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom performs the token movement through _transfer.
transferFrom updates the spender allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance through the internal _approve.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance using tokenFromReflection.
_transfer queries balanceOf for the max-wallet and contract balance checks.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when the contract balance threshold is met.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to fees after a successful swap.
_transfer finishes by invoking _tokenTransfer with the resolved fee flag.
_tokenTransfer removes fees when the transfer is fee exempt.
_tokenTransfer executes the standard reflection transfer.
_tokenTransfer restores the cached fees after a fee-exempt transfer.
_transferStandard obtains all t and r values from _getValues.
_transferStandard credits the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee through _reflectFee.
_takeTeam reads the current rate to convert team tokens to reflections.
_getValues derives the t breakdown from _getTValues.
_getValues fetches the current reflection rate.
_getValues derives the r breakdown from _getRValues.
_getRate obtains the reflection and token supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned by _getRate.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend the contract tokens.
swapTokensForEth performs the Uniswap router swap external call.
sendETHToFee performs the raw ETH transfer to the marketing address.
manualsend forwards the whole ETH balance via sendETHToFee.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the full contract token balance.
manualswap reads the contract token balance via balanceOf.
transfer uses the caller address as the source of the transfer.
_transfer receives the caller-derived from address and performs owner comparisons.
_approve is called with the caller as owner/spender context.
approve passes the caller as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses the caller as the spender whose allowance is decremented, enabling approval-based draining if allowances are granted.
manualswap authorization depends solely on the caller matching the privileged addresses.
manualsend authorization depends solely on the caller matching the privileged addresses.
The onlyOwner modifier compares the caller against the stored owner.
Privilege evaluation reads the untrusted caller to decide if a protected function body runs.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline, introducing timestamp dependency.
The external router call deadline is derived from block.timestamp.
_developmentAddress is one of the two addresses authorized to call manualswap.
_developmentAddress is one of the two addresses authorized to call manualsend.
_marketingAddress is one of the two addresses authorized to call manualsend.
sendETHToFee routes the contract ETH to the marketing address.
tradingOpen gates whether non-owner senders may transfer, a privileged restriction on user funds.
_maxTxAmount bounds the transfer amount checked in _transfer.
_maxWalletSize bounds the recipient balance checked in _transfer.
_swapTokensAtAmount determines whether the contract balance triggers an auto-swap.
swapEnabled gates whether owner-controlled swaps happen during user transfers.
_isExcludedFromFee is consulted to skip fees for privileged accounts.
The active redistribution fee is multiplied into the amount when computing t values.
The active tax fee is multiplied into the amount when computing t values.
_transferStandard reads and writes reflection balances in _rOwned.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
swapTokensForEth interacts with the stored Uniswap router instance.
owner() exposes the privileged owner address.
_transfer refuses transfers involving blacklisted bots.
The inSwap flag written by lockTheSwap guards reentrant swap execution.
The Uniswap router swap transfers the token and can reenter token transfer logic before state settles.
The raw ETH transfer can invoke the recipient receive hook and reenter the contract.
The contract ETH balance read determines the amount forwarded to sendETHToFee.
setTrading is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
blockBots is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
unblockBot is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
setFee is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxnAmount is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxWalletSize is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
setMinSwapTokensThreshold is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.
toggleSwap is restricted to the owner via the onlyOwner modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter of transfer only flows into _transfer; fold it into that function node.
The recipient parameter of transfer is consumed by _transfer.
The spender parameter of approve is written by _approve.
The sender parameter of transferFrom is passed into _transfer.
The recipient parameter of transferFrom is passed into _transfer.
The new trading flag is stored by setTrading only.
The notbot parameter is used solely by unblockBot.
The bots_ array is iterated by blockBots only.
The maxTxAmount parameter is assigned to _maxTxAmount by setMaxTxnAmount.
The maxWalletSize parameter is assigned by setMaxWalletSize.
The swap threshold parameter is set by setMinSwapTokensThreshold.
The swap flag parameter is set by toggleSwap.
redisFeeOnBuy is written to state by setFee.
redisFeeOnSell is written to state by setFee.
taxFeeOnBuy is written to state by setFee.
taxFeeOnSell is written to state by setFee.
The accounts array is looped over by excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
The excluded flag is applied by excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
The from parameter drives all gate checks inside _transfer.
The to parameter drives pair detection and limits inside _transfer.
The amount parameter is validated and passed to _tokenTransfer by _transfer.
tokenAmount is the swap input used by swapTokensForEth.
amount is the ETH value forwarded by sendETHToFee.
tAmount feeds the reflection math inside _transferStandard.
The sender parameter updates the reflection balance in _transferStandard.
The recipient parameter updates the reflection balance in _transferStandard.
rAmount is validated and converted by tokenFromReflection.
newOwner is validated and stored by transferOwnership.
tTeam is converted into a reflection credit by _takeTeam.
rFee is subtracted from the reflection supply by _reflectFee.
tFee is accumulated into the fee total by _reflectFee.
The contract token balance snapshot is a scratch value inside _transfer.
canSwap is a scratch boolean used only inside _transfer.
The ETH balance snapshot is a scratch value used only inside _transfer.
currentRate is the rate value obtained from _getRate.
tTransferAmount is an intermediate returned by _getTValues into _getValues.
tFee is computed and returned by _getTValues.
tTeam is computed and returned by _getTValues.
rAmount is computed and returned by _getRValues.
rTransferAmount is computed and returned by _getRValues.
rFee is computed and returned by _getRValues.
takeFee controls fee removal/restoration inside _tokenTransfer.
rSupply is a local supply value inside _getCurrentSupply.
tSupply is a local supply value inside _getCurrentSupply.
The loop index is a scratch counter inside blockBots.
rTeam is the reflection team amount computed inside _takeTeam.
The contract balance local is a scratch value inside manualswap.
The ETH balance local is a scratch value inside manualsend.
